body:
Rust test filters for `cargo test --bin termal <filter>` must use the module path, not the file name. Many files under src/tests/ are mounted with `#[path = "file.rs"] mod short_name;` inside a parent module. For example, src/tests/acceptance_evaluation_evidence_recovery.rs is tests::acceptance_evaluation::evidence_recovery (src/tests/acceptance_evaluation.rs:86), and acceptance_evaluation_evidence.rs is tests::acceptance_evaluation::evidence_selection.

Before naming a filter in a RED/GREEN request, grep the parent for the `#[path = "<file>"]` line, and make "running 0 tests" an explicit STOP. A wrong filter passes vacuously with exit 0. It cost one RED and one GREEN leg on DL560 for w-ff5fc754e13d (2026-11-20).
